title: Adjuster Report Governing a Contents Proof of Loss — NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
Desk rule for contents claims on the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own): the adjuster report from which a contents proof of loss swears its contents loss.

**Rule.** The adjuster report a contents proof of loss swears from is settled as follows: when the claim's latest SUPPLEMENTAL report was filed after its latest FINAL report and measures a contents loss above zero, it is that SUPPLEMENTAL report; when the claim has no FINAL report, it is the claim's latest PRELIMINARY report; otherwise it is the claim's latest FINAL report.

## Decision lines

1. Does the claim carry a FINAL report? If not, the latest PRELIMINARY report governs.
2. If it does: was the latest SUPPLEMENTAL report filed after the latest FINAL report, and does it measure a contents loss above zero? If both, that SUPPLEMENTAL report governs.
3. Otherwise the latest FINAL report governs.

A SUPPLEMENTAL report filed on the same day as the latest FINAL report is not filed after it.

## Cases (hypothetical claim files)

| Reports | Contents loss on the latest SUPPLEMENTAL | Governing report |
|---|---|---|
| FINAL 3 April; SUPPLEMENTAL 28 May | 6,400.00 | the SUPPLEMENTAL of 28 May |
| FINAL 3 April; SUPPLEMENTAL 28 May | 0.00 (building only) | the FINAL of 3 April |
| PRELIMINARY 10 March and 2 April; no FINAL | — | the PRELIMINARY of 2 April |
